visual.summary: Level 2 adds an oak tree, lamp posts at the corners and a notice board, which helps, but the square is still mostly flat grey cobblestone.
problems: Same floor problem as L1: one grey cobblestone everywhere; mix in stone brick borders and gravel or dirt paths
Add a bench ring or planter around the tree trunk so the tree sits in the square instead of on it
The well roof is still a flat plank lid

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: polished_andesite, red_wool, stone_brick_wall, chiseled_stone_bricks, light_weighted_pressure_plate, red_banner.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Level 2 makes it a real village square: a statue of the king in red with a gold crown and a banner, lantern posts, benches round the plaza and a market stall with a pitched roof.
problems: Few plants: the planters by the benches could carry flowers already at this level
